lostItems.heading: Lost property
lostItems.text: You can ask about lost property by emailing <1>toimitila@luuppi.fi</1>.

when.question: How/when do I get the keys?
when.answer: By default, the keys are handed over at Pii-Klubi at the start time of the rental.

delegate.question: Can I authorize someone else to pick up the keys?

return.question: How/when do I return the keys?
return.answer: The keys are left in the return box, which is pointed out when the keys are handed over.

viewing.question: Can I come see the space beforehand?
viewing.answer: You can view the space by booking a viewing time. Email <1>toimitila@luuppi.fi</1> to book a viewing.

where.question: Where will I get the invoice?
where.answer: The invoice is sent to the email address or e-invoicing address given at the time of booking.

when.question: When will I get the invoice?
when.answer: Invoices are sent approximately two weeks after the rental.

supplies.question: Are cleaning supplies available on site?
supplies.answer: Yes. The venue has supplies suitable for both general and final cleaning.

booking.question: How do I book final cleaning for my rental?
booking.answer: You can book the cleaning by emailing <1>info@juniperlux.fi</1>.

mandatory.question: Is final cleaning mandatory?
mandatory.answer: No. Final cleaning can also be done yourself using the supplies available at Pii-Klubi.

confirmed.question: Is my final cleaning confirmed?
confirmed.answer: We are not responsible for cleaning, so direct any questions about final cleaning to <1>info@juniperlux.fi</1>.

animals.question: Bring animals?
animals.answer: Pets are not allowed at Pii-Klubi, but official service dogs are permitted. For exceptions, contact <1>toimitila@luuppi.fi</1>.

smoking.question: Smoke?
smoking.answer: No. Smoking is only allowed outside in the designated area.

wifi.question: Wifi?
wifi.answer: Yes. The wifi details can be found in the pink renter's folder at Pii-Klubi.

soundSystem.question: A sound system?
soundSystem.answer: Yes. Pii-Klubi has two RCF Art 412A tweeter + RCF Sub 705-AS subwoofer combinations, which fill the whole hall with high-quality, clear sound. The sound system can be connected via AUX or Bluetooth.

microphones.question: Microphones?
microphones.answer: Yes, Pii-Klubi has two microphones connected to the sound system.
